description: Structured eval definitions for the SSM Association Operator. Five-case proven set exercising the OPERATION_COMPLETED / REVIEW_REQUIRED classification across association configurations (tag-targeted scheduled association with integer rate control and KMS-encrypted S3 output, instance-ID-targeted association for pet servers, compliance-driven remediation association with EventBridge wiring, multi-document step-document association, missing customer-managed KMS key on output bucket). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Tag-targeted scheduled association with integer rate control and KMS-encrypted output
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — tag targets (dynamic), rate(30 minutes) schedule, apply-at-creation, integer rate control (max-concurrency=10, max-errors=3), SSE-KMS output bucket
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM State Manager association named PatchProductionFleet in us-east-1. Use document AWS-ApplyPatchBaseline. Target instances tagged Environment=production. Schedule rate(30 minutes). Run immediately on creation. Allow 10 instances in parallel and stop after 3 errors. Parameters: Operation=Install, SnapshotId=latest. Route output to s3://my-ssm-output/ssm-output/ (bucket has SSE-KMS with key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc123). Tags: Environment=production, Owner=cloudops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_ASSOCIATION: PatchProductionFleet (a-1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Document: AWS-ApplyPatchBaseline (default version)
  [✓] Targets: tag:Environment=production (dynamic)
  [✓] Schedule: rate(30 minutes)
  [✓] Apply-at-creation: ENABLED
  [✓] Rate control: max-concurrency=10, max-errors=3 (integer form)
  [✓] Output S3: s3://my-ssm-output/ssm-output/ (SSE-KMS)
  [✓] Parameters: Operation=Install, SnapshotId=latest
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ssm describe-association --association-id a-1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9 --region us-east-1
  aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket my-ssm-output --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Instance-ID-targeted association for pet servers
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — static instance-ID targeting, cron(0 0 3 ? * SUN *) schedule, integer rate control (1/1 for one-at-a-time)
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM State Manager association named HardenPetServers in us-east-1. Use custom document Custom-HardenBaseline (default version). Target instance IDs i-aaa111bb222 and i-ccc333dd444. Schedule cron(0 0 3 ? * SUN *) (03:00 UTC every Sunday). Run on creation. Integer rate control: max-concurrency=1, max-errors=1. Route output to s3://my-ssm-output/ssm-output/ (SSE-KMS enabled). Parameters: Mode=Strict.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_ASSOCIATION: HardenPetServers (a-2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Document: Custom-HardenBaseline (default version)
  [✓] Targets: InstanceIds=i-aaa111bb222,i-ccc333dd444 (static)
  [✓] Schedule: cron(0 0 3 ? * SUN *)
  [✓] Apply-at-creation: ENABLED
  [✓] Rate control: max-concurrency=1, max-errors=1 (integer form)
  [✓] Output S3: s3://my-ssm-output/ssm-output/ (SSE-KMS)
  [✓] Parameters: Mode=Strict

eval_cases.name: Compliance-driven association with EventBridge auto-remediation
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — tag targets, GatherSoftwareInventory document, EventBridge rule on NON_COMPLIANT triggering StartAssociationsOnce, idempotency prerequisite
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM State Manager association named InventoryProduction in us-east-1. Use document AWS-GatherSoftwareInventory. Target instances tagged Environment=production. Schedule rate(30 minutes). Apply at creation. Integer rate control: max-concurrency=50, max-errors=5. Output to s3://my-ssm-output/ssm-output/ (SSE-KMS). Wire this association for auto-remediation when the compliance state flips to NON_COMPLIANT — EventBridge rule triggering StartAssociationsOnce. Confirm AWS-GatherSoftwareInventory is idempotent.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_ASSOCIATION: InventoryProduction (a-3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j1)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Document: AWS-GatherSoftwareInventory
  [✓] Targets: tag:Environment=production (dynamic)
  [✓] Schedule: rate(30 minutes)
  [✓] Compliance: COMPLIANT (after first run)
  [✓] Remediation: EventBridge rule on NON_COMPLIANT → StartAssociationsOnce
  [✓] Idempotency: AWS-GatherSoftwareInventory is idempotent (safe to re-run)

eval_cases.name: Custom step-document with sequential install-then-configure
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — custom step-document with two sequential mainSteps, default version set, association pinned to default version, tag:Role=web targets
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM State Manager association named ProvisionWebFleet in us-east-1. Use a custom step document Custom-WebFleetProvision that runs two steps in sequence: installPackage (yum install -y httpd) then configureService (systemctl enable and start httpd). Document is at ./custom-webfleet-provision.yaml. Set the document default version. Target instances tagged Role=web. Schedule cron(0 0 4 ? * MON-FRI *) (04:00 UTC Mon-Fri). Apply at creation. Integer rate control: max-concurrency=5, max-errors=2. Output to s3://my-ssm-output/ssm-output/ (SSE-KMS enabled).
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_ASSOCIATION: ProvisionWebFleet (a-4d5e6f7g8h9i0j1k2)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Document: Custom-WebFleetProvision (default version set)
  [✓] Steps: installPackage → configureService (sequential)
  [✓] Targets: tag:Role=web (dynamic)
  [✓] Schedule: cron(0 0 4 ? * MON-FRI *)
  [✓] Rate control: max-concurrency=5, max-errors=2 (integer form)
  [✓] Output S3: s3://my-ssm-output/ssm-output/ (SSE-KMS)

eval_cases.name: Association with SSE-S3 output bucket (no customer-managed KMS key)
eval_cases.branch: REVIEW_REQUIRED — output bucket has SSE-S3 (S3-managed keys) but no customer-managed KMS key; execution artifacts may contain secrets
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM State Manager association named PatchDevFleet in us-east-1. Use document AWS-ApplyPatchBaseline. Target instances tagged Environment=dev. Schedule rate(1 hour). Apply at creation. Integer rate control: max-concurrency=5, max-errors=2. Route output to s3://dev-ssm-output/output/ — this bucket has SSE-S3 (S3-managed keys) but no customer-managed KMS key.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_ASSOCIATION: PatchDevFleet
VERDICT: REVIEW_REQUIRED
CHECKLIST:
  [!] Output S3: s3://dev-ssm-output/output/ has SSE-S3 but no customer-managed KMS key — execution artifacts can contain secrets
